fieldValues.comment_text: A lock inside the server does not cover this as long as transport is stdio: each session runs its own server process (several were live on 2026-11-04), and an in-process lock cannot see the others. The lock needs to be a per-repository lock file, or the writers need to share one server process. A save pass would take the same lock file, so it never commits half a write. This comment is the agent's reading, not the owner's words.
